definitions.ephemeral_artifact: a .md artefact at least one channel observed, whose basename no corpus repo has ever added on any ref (`git log --all --diff-filter=A`, so committed-then-deleted counts as SURVIVING)
definitions.lower_bound: every count is a floor. A file created, used and deleted without ever being typed in a prompt or written by an agent tool call is invisible to all three channels
definitions.attribution_path: resolved from a full PycharmProjects/IdeaProjects path - exact
definitions.attribution_session_folder: resolved from the session's project only - WS3 showed this misattributes (a file named in a btest session may belong to harp), so these are counted separately and never merged
definitions.why_WS1_is_not_rescored: existence is recoverable; content is not. A rubric axis needs an artefact's contents to score. This file measures a confound and never corrects a score
definitions.conservative_by_construction: the committed pool is the UNION over all corpus repos and matching is on basename only, so any same-named file anywhere rescues an artefact from the ephemeral count

_meta.verification: Hand-verified before publication: (1) all 33 observed blive artefacts confirmed present in blive's git by independent enumeration - the zero is real, not an artefact of low observation (channels saw 33 of blive's 50 committed .md files); (2) eodhd_uk_eu_migration_plan.md and data_acquisition_prompts.md confirmed absent from every corpus repo by an independent per-repo shell loop over 'git log --all --diff-filter=A'. Two regex bugs were caught by hand-reading the first output: MD_PATH_RE ran greedily across sentence text and manufactured an artefact named 'btest only, plan a safe doc-reorganization ... eodhd_uk_eu_migration_plan.md', and MD_TOKEN_RE's length floor admitted prose fragments '_v2.md' and '_v3.md' as artefacts. is_plausible_basename() is the fix.
_meta.portability_note: channels B and C are machine-local stores. Inside a corporate environment (PLAN.md 5) they will differ or be absent; each is optional and its absence is reported rather than silently treated as zero
